packageRules.description: A Python minor (3.14 -> 3.15) is a runtime upgrade for every instance that runs Python as its app runtime: its own runtime Dockerfile must move in step, and its tools must support the new version. Keep it out of the automerged group, as its own PR for manual review.

Pin container images to their digest. Scoped to the docker managers on purpose: a global pinDigests also hits the pre-commit manager, whose tag revs can't be converted to digests (the update fails). GitHub Actions are pinned by helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests instead.
Renovate can't regenerate .devcontainer/devcontainer-lock.json, so features are bumped by hand together with it (see .devcontainer/README.md).

Feature test pins (test/**) pair each version with sha256s Renovate can't compute. Their PR fails the feature tests until a maintainer updates the shas by hand, so it gets its own group and never automerges (docs/adrs/0002-resolve-pins-from-option-env-or-pins-file-with-no-defaults.md).
prBodyNotes: Renovate bumped only the versions. Update every sha256 next to each bumped version (option, ENV line or pins file) before merging; the feature tests fail until you do.

customManagers.description: Feature test pins in scenarios.json: a "//renovate" key, then the "version" it tracks with no closing brace in between (docs/adrs/0002-resolve-pins-from-option-env-or-pins-file-with-no-defaults.md).
Feature test pins for the image-environment and pins-file channels: a "# renovate:" comment directly above an ENV KEY=value or [export] KEY=value line (the legacy ENV KEY value form is not matched).
Version pins in features.yml's env: block (the Dev Container CLI, kept in step with scripts/develop.d/10-devcontainer-cli.sh).
